newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bullish trend continues on Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bullish trend continues on Oslo Bourse.

text.p: The Norwegian Total index charged ahead to a new all-time high for the seventh consecutive session on Wednesday amid warnings a correction may be around the corner.
The index closed at 871.57, up 0.52 percent from Tuesday in healthy turnover of 875 million crowns. Blue chip continued to drive up trade and foreign investors were reported to be active.
Shipping group Bergesen B shares were up 2.90 percent at 142 crowns and industrial giant Norsk Hydro gained 0.48 percent to finish at 312.50 crowns.
Offshore group Aker, which will report 8-months results on Thursday, saw its A share up 2.38 percent at 129 crowns.

Food-based conglomerate Orkla, which has climbed strongly following last week's eight-months profits, fell 1.1 percent to 395.50 in what appeared to be profit-taking. Trade in Orkla totalled 88 million crowns.

"I am expecting a correction soon, but there will be a further upswing later," one analyst said. "The underlying fundamentals are strong. I expect the oil price to continue to be high and that the interest rates will rise a bit."
